preconditions.expression: isinstance(matrix, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: matrix is a list of lists representing a 2D grid.

preconditions.expression: len(matrix) >= 1 and all(len(row) == len(matrix[0]) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The matrix has at least one row and all rows have the same length C.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in (0, 1) for row in matrix for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Every cell in the matrix contains either 0 or 1.
The dimensions R and C satisfy the constraints 1 <= R <= 1000 and 1 <= C <= 20.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, list) and all(isinstance(i, int) for i in return_value)
postconditions.description: The return value is a list of integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < len(matrix) for i in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every returned index is a valid row number within the matrix bounds.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sorted([i for i in range(1, len(matrix)) if any(matrix[i] == matrix[j] for j in range(i))])
postconditions.description: The list contains exactly those row indices i (where i > 0) such that row i is identical to at least one preceding row j (where j < i), sorted in ascending order.
